models_evaluated: Hybrid CNN + LSTM wheeze detection model trained on public electronic stethoscope databases

links.outcome: Wheeze detection accuracy and F1-score across pediatric age subgroups
links.effect: Overall accuracy 87% (95% CI 86-89), F1 61% (56-66); best accuracy in adolescents (92%), best F1 in pre-school children (64%), so performance varied by age group.
links.quote: The best accuracy was found in adolescents (92%, 95% CI 90-94) and the best global F1-score in pre-school children recordings (64%, 95% CI 58-71).

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning a model trained on electronic stethoscope data using smartphone-recorded audio
Recording-quality screening of smartphone audio before AI analysis

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of a deep learning model (CNN+LSTM) applied to smartphone-recorded pediatric lung sounds collected prospectively in a hospital setting, comparing it against expert manual annotations without evaluating a specific implementation guardrail or deployment practice.
